scope: Uniform synthetic blocking-temperature bands, instantaneous erasure above each threshold, acquisition on last downward crossing, common upward field axis, linear recording, no relaxation or chemistry. Known new contribution is reported separately from unresolved initial remanence. Its bound assumes |initial magnetization| <= reference_magnetization_a_m. Bands are not measured mineral spectra; 575 C is below the illustrative magnetite ordering point, not evidence for magnetite.
observation_scope: Exact on-axis fields for a flat finite layered cylinder and independent Gaussian noise; an ideal known-template detection benchmark, not an instrument or orbital inversion. Reference amplitude, dimensions and noise are arbitrary declared inputs.

refinement.scope: 16 phases at each of 5, 20 and 100 Myr chron durations; exact piecewise-linear kernel integration is the production result. Thermal grid refinement is a numerical check, not geological uncertainty.

unknown_initial_record: Known new contribution is a conditional lower-information calculation, not the total field. Unknown initial contribution can add or subtract up to the explicit bound. The bound assumes the reference amplitude also bounds prehistory.
